Class LTSminUtil

java.lang.Object
net.automatalib.modelchecker.ltsmin.LTSminUtil
public final class LTSminUtil extends Object
A utility class that encapsulates certain technical aspects of LTSmin (e.g. accessibility of the binary, etc.)
